selection: Fresh holdout: four issuers new to the corpus, chosen for layout families the parser was not developed on: two EDINET-rendered annual securities reports (Japanese GAAP finance industry; IFRS), one Antenna House annual securities report (IFRS) and one TAKARA PRINTING earnings release (Japanese GAAP construction). For each, the consolidated balance sheet over both its pages and the income or comprehensive income statement. Pages were chosen from text-layer titles and rendered pages before any parser run on these files. Page numbers are 1-based PDF positions.
annotation: Single-assistant visual transcription checked against every selected rendered page before the first parser run on these files. A text-layer listing independent of jpfs was used only as a transcription aid. Paths, units and dates are explicit; semantic paths follow the earlier batches (totals under their section even when printed at the heading's indentation; wrapped labels joined). The gold's own totals were checked against their members within display rounding. Not independently human-adjudicated.
